products.notes: 50 lb professional turf and landscape fertilizer with a 3-1-2 ratio and sulfur. Derived from ammonium nitrate, monoammonium phosphate, diammonium phosphate, calcium phosphate, and sulfate of potash. The supplied label lists turf rates of 6 lb/1,000 sq ft preplant, 5 lb/1,000 sq ft established turf, and 4 lb/1,000 sq ft overseeding. A 50 lb bag covers about 8,300 sq ft at the preplant rate or 10,000 sq ft at the established-turf rate. Apply to dry foliage and moist soil, spread evenly, then irrigate. Current Yara labeling limits phosphorus-containing turf use to the first growing season, repaired or renovated turf, or turf where a soil test within the last three years indicates phosphorus deficiency; it is not intended for routine turf maintenance. Follow the current product label and applicable state nutrient rules.
